articles.title_en: Russia has spent nearly 19 trillion rubles on weapons and ammunition it wouldn’t have needed without the war — money effectively lost to the economy, Novaya Gazeta Europe reports
articles.lead_en: Russian authorities have already spent an “excess” 18.6 trillion rubles on weapons and ammunition since the start of the full-scale war, the independent Russian news outlet Novaya Gazeta Europe calculated. These costs emerged only because of the war and never returned to the economy, the outlet said.
